versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobEndNotification upon successful end of an asynchronous erase operation after performing all necessary internal management operations. Successful end of an asynchronous erase operation implies the erase job for immediate data is finished and the result is OK (see SWS_Ea_00064).
